sections.heading: The Ranchers Vehicles Guide: Driving, Parking and Travel
sections.text: Vehicles are the long-distance option for exploring Sunvale, reaching town services and moving between the ranch and city. They are useful when a quest asks you to drive, when a supply run would otherwise take too long, or when you need to carry a route through the open world. They are not the only travel system: the Subway covers local fast travel, and selected main quests can skip the driving segment.

sections.heading: The Ranchers Vehicles Guide: Driving, Parking and Travel
sections.text: The June transport update describes a revised driving system and vehicle categories, but it does not provide a stable public comparison of top speed, fuel economy or purchase value. Treat “best vehicle” claims as unverified unless they include a build, method and reproducible test.

sections.heading: The Ranchers Vehicles Guide: Driving, Parking and Travel
sections.text: There is no single universal unlock condition confirmed by the sources retained here. The safe route is to follow the opening quest chain and read the objective shown in your current build.

sections.heading: The Ranchers Vehicles Guide: Driving, Parking and Travel
sections.text: Current gameplay reference: the opening quest chain includes repairing Victor's old car, using the Bykii terminal while it is unavailable, and then collecting the new car. This is a video observation from 0.8.10.455, not a promise that every save or future build uses the same timing.

sections.heading: The Ranchers Vehicles Guide: Driving, Parking and Travel
sections.text: Dealerships: the official transport announcement names several city dealerships, but the announcement does not establish a complete current price list or a universal purchase requirement. Use the map and the in-game objective rather than an old list.

sections.heading: The Ranchers Vehicles Guide: Driving, Parking and Travel
sections.text: Stolen vehicles: replace the plate at AutoHue before expecting My Garage to manage the vehicle. Forged plates have a separate permanent-seizure risk outside approved parking.

sections.heading: Vehicle catalogue
sections.text: Editor-collected vehicle definitions from build 0.8.10.842. Names and short descriptions come from the bilingual game text; dealer links come from separate shop tables. Catalogue presence does not establish current drivability or availability.

sections.heading: Vehicle catalogue
sections.text: This name comes from a separate Misc build definition and is not one of the 40 general vehicle catalogue records below. Its I2 description slot is empty, and its item flags do not establish current drivability, performance, a repair price or a quest reward.

sections.heading: Transport service objects
sections.text: Only 4 of 186 NetEnvObj environment definitions have player-readable transport names. The other 182 are internal identifiers or lack localization, so they are not promoted to places. Environment-object names alone do not establish exact coordinates, prices, current operation or availability; dialogue terms are listed separately below.

sections.text: Rental, repair & travel terms

sections.heading: Transport service objects
sections.text: These terms come from current-build bilingual dialogue and matching actions. Listed amounts are not individually gameplay-tested; current operation and complete destinations remain unknown.

sections.heading: Transport service objects
sections.text: Bicycle rental terminal The bilingual terminal dialogue lists a 1 C day rental and a 100 C destruction penalty. It checks stock, deducts 1 C, marks the assigned bicycle with a green light and says staff collect it at day's end.

sections.heading: Transport service objects
sections.text: Taxi rental terminal The bilingual TaxiCo dialogue lists a 10 C day rental and a 100 C destruction penalty. It checks stock, deducts 10 C, marks the assigned taxi with a green light and reports when no taxi is available.

sections.heading: Transport service objects
sections.text: Vehicle repair dialogue The country-mechanic path checks merchant availability, repairable vehicle content and sufficient funds before invoking a repair-all action; the displayed total is runtime-filled and no fixed amount is retained.

sections.heading: Transport service objects
sections.text: Subway travel actions The subway dialogue exposes local travel, international travel and a return-to-ranch action. A matching local-ticket node checks and deducts 3 C; a separate current-build line describes the metro as open 24/7, but runtime operation and the destination list remain untested.

sections.heading: Transport service objects
sections.text: Remote portal travel action Remote-portal dialogue describes entry to a shared space for meeting other Ranchers, includes respect/privacy/reporting guidance, and exposes options to return to the player's ranch or visit a friend. No fee, destination list or current availability is established.

sections.heading: No matched dealer record
sections.text: Drive the route or use the quest option. When a selected main quest offers skip driving, the vehicle and listed passengers can be transported to the destination.

sections.heading: No matched dealer record
sections.text: Park deliberately. Return to the ranch or use one of the designated Overnight Parking locations. A random roadside space is not automatically approved parking.

sections.heading: No matched dealer record
sections.text: Use My Garage for recovery. Open the smartphone app and check whether the owned vehicle is still listed. Broken, destroyed, drowned or stuck vehicles can be sent to the mechanic.

sections.heading: No matched dealer record
sections.text: Check the return location. Repaired vehicles are returned through the nearest Car Pound parking location. The map directory can help you identify the relevant transport area.

sections.heading: No matched dealer record
sections.text: Handle stolen vehicles separately. Go to AutoHue for the plate step before treating My Garage as the recovery route.

sections.heading: No matched dealer record
sections.text: Sunvale currently has 15 Subway stations. Use the Subway when the destination is covered by local travel instead of driving the whole route. Attached or roped animals can travel with the player; the 0.8.10.562 hotfix specifically fixed a reported freeze path for roped animals after Subway travel.

sections.heading: No matched dealer record
sections.text: Quest travel is a separate path. Selected main quests offer a skip-driving option that transports the vehicle, passengers, NPCs and farm animals listed by the official update. If the option is absent, do not assume every quest supports it.

sections.heading: No matched dealer record
sections.text: Use the interactive map for transport areas and parking directory entries, and the Subway troubleshooting page when the problem is travel rather than vehicle ownership.

sections.heading: No matched dealer record
sections.text: Keep the symptom narrow. “Vehicle missing after loading,” “vehicle unresponsive at AutoHue,” and “roped animal frozen after Subway travel” are different reports with different known histories.

sections.heading: No matched dealer record
sections.text: Confirm the title-screen build is 0.8.10.842 or later and keep the original save.

sections.heading: No matched dealer record
sections.text: Open My Garage and check the owned-vehicle list.

sections.heading: No matched dealer record
sections.text: For damage, water, destruction or a stuck vehicle, send it to the mechanic.

sections.heading: No matched dealer record
sections.text: Check the nearest Car Pound and the last approved parking location.

sections.heading: No matched dealer record
sections.text: If the vehicle is still absent, record platform, save context, last location, trigger and before/after state, then use the contribution form .

sections.heading: No matched dealer record
sections.text: In co-op, decide who is driving and who is handling the destination before starting a long route. Official quest-travel notes include passengers, NPCs and farm animals in the selected skip-driving transfer, but they do not establish a general shared-vehicle ownership rule.

sections.heading: No matched dealer record
sections.text: There is no retained official confirmation that every player can freely drive another player's owned vehicle. Treat the car's owner and the quest's temporary vehicle as separate cases: check the relevant My Garage list, the current objective and the build before calling it a bug. If a friend cannot join, use the multiplayer guide rather than treating it as a vehicle problem.

sections.text: Unofficial reference. All 40 names and 40 description slots were checked against the raw I2 bytes; empty descriptions remain empty. Internal prices and raw developer fields are not published. 0.8.10.842 · Steam 24847725. A dealer record does not guarantee current stock or a complete price; no matched record does not prove unavailability. Drive the route or use the quest option. When a selected main quest offers skip driving, the vehicle and listed passengers can be transported to the destination. Park deliberately. Return to the ranch or use one of the designated Overnight Parking locations. A random roadside space is not automatically approved parking. Use My Garage for recovery. Open the smartphone app and check whether the owned vehicle is still listed. Broken, destroyed, drowned or stuck vehicles can be sent to the mechanic. Check the return location. Repaired vehicles are returned through the nearest Car Pound parking location. The map directory can help you identify the relevant transport area. Handle stolen vehicles separately. Go to AutoHue for the plate step before treating My Garage as the recovery route. Sunvale currently has 15 Subway stations. Use the Subway when the destination is covered by local travel instead of driving the whole route. Attached or roped animals can travel with the player; the 0.8.10.562 hotfix specifically fixed a reported freeze path for roped animals after Subway travel. Quest travel is a separate path. Selected main quests offer a skip-driving option that transports the vehicle, passengers, NPCs and farm animals listed by the official update. If the option is absent, do not assume every quest supports it. Use the interactive map for transport areas and parking directory entries, and the Subway troubleshooting page when the problem is travel rather than vehicle ownership. Keep the symptom narrow. “Vehicle missing after loading,” “vehicle unresponsive at AutoHue,” and “roped animal frozen after Subway travel” are different reports with different known histories. Confirm the title-screen build is 0.8.10.842 or later and keep the original save. Open My Garage and check the owned-vehicle list. For damage, water, destruction or a stuck vehicle, send it to the mechanic. Check the nearest Car Pound and the last approved parking location. If the vehicle is still absent, record platform, save context, last location, trigger and before/after state, then use the contribution form . In co-op, decide who is driving and who is handling the destination before starting a long route. Official quest-travel notes include passengers, NPCs and farm animals in the selected skip-driving transfer, but they do not establish a general shared-vehicle ownership rule. There is no retained official confirmation that every player can freely drive another player's owned vehicle. Treat the car's owner and the quest's temporary vehicle as separate cases: check the relevant My Garage list, the current objective and the build before calling it a bug. If a friend cannot join, use the multiplayer guide rather than treating it as a vehicle problem. The 40-entry build catalogue records source definitions, not a confirmed list of currently drivable vehicles. No speed, handling, fuel or profit ranking is published. No universal dealership price or unlock condition is inferred from the announcement. Older Alpha or demo driving advice is historical unless it has a current-build reproduction.

title: Roof Quest Stuck in The Ranchers? Building Quest Fixes That Work
description: The Ranchers roof quest not completing? The quest tracker getting stuck is an officially confirmed known issue. Try the phone quest journal (T), sleep to the next day, or restart — plus fixes for missing roof and door blueprints at the workbench.

sections.heading: Roof Quest Stuck in The Ranchers? Building Quest Fixes That Work
sections.text: Updated for Early Access 0.8.10.x (August 2026) · August 7, 2026 · Reading time: ~7 min

sections.heading: Roof Quest Stuck in The Ranchers? Building Quest Fixes That Work
sections.text: If your roof quest will not complete after you built the roof, you are not alone — this was one of the most-reported problems on the Steam discussion board in the first week of August 2026, with players posting about it in English, German and Russian, and some getting stuck even earlier at the first step of placing stairs ( Tutorial build roof , Aug 4; Whitebear, Aug 2; Campingqueen769, Aug 3).

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: The quest tracker getting stuck is an officially confirmed known issue Official . Do these three things in order:

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: Press T and check the quest journal on your phone — the next objective may already be listed there even though the on-screen tracker looks stuck, and you can keep playing.

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: Sleep to the next day.

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: Restart the game client (save first, then fully quit and relaunch).

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: If the real problem is that you cannot find the roof, door or bed blueprints at the workbench, that is a different issue — a scrolling UI quirk — covered in Symptom B below.

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: Symptom A: roof built, quest will not complete

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: Symptom B: no roof, door or bed blueprint at the workbench

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: Symptom C: cannot build a door

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: Symptom D: hole in the middle of the roof

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: Troubleshooting flow

sections.heading: Symptom A: roof built, quest will not complete (tracker stuck)
sections.text: Official Corroborated by players

sections.heading: Symptom A: roof built, quest will not complete (tracker stuck)
sections.text: This is the officially confirmed case. Moderator/support Jennoula confirmed in "Tutorial build roof" (Aug 4, 2026) that "there is a known issue with the quest tracker sometimes getting stuck," and gave the workarounds that have worked for almost every player so far:

sections.heading: Symptom A: roof built, quest will not complete (tracker stuck)
sections.text: Press T and see whether your next objective shows up in the phone quest journal. The on-screen tracker may still look stuck, but you can continue the quest anyway.

sections.heading: Symptom A: roof built, quest will not complete (tracker stuck)
sections.text: Sleep to the next day — this sometimes gets the tracker moving again.

sections.heading: Symptom A: roof built, quest will not complete (tracker stuck)
sections.text: Restart the game client.

sections.heading: Symptom A: roof built, quest will not complete (tracker stuck)
sections.text: The developers are still investigating why the tracker gets stuck, but you should be able to continue in the meantime.

sections.heading: Symptom A: roof built, quest will not complete (tracker stuck)
sections.text: Two independent players corroborate the restart/logout route in "Cant finish Roof quest...?" (Aug 3): X-C0brA-X saved, restarted the game, and the quest showed as finished after the restart; KnottyBoy did the quest steps via the phone journal, then logged totally out and back in, after which the on-screen quest passed.

sections.heading: Symptom B: no roof, door or bed blueprint at the workbench (UI scrolling)
sections.text: Corroborated by players

sections.heading: Symptom B: no roof, door or bed blueprint at the workbench (UI scrolling)
sections.text: Before assuming your game is broken, check how far you scrolled. In "Missing roof" (Aug 2), SUwUMaBUwU pointed out that roofs and beds sit far to the right in the building tab list — scroll slowly with the mouse wheel, because scrolling too far flips you over to the furniture tab. Minay, who had restarted and even started a new save without success, confirmed that scrolling slowly with the mouse wheel revealed the roofs and beds.

sections.heading: Symptom B: no roof, door or bed blueprint at the workbench (UI scrolling)
sections.text: A second, independent group reported the same class of problem for door blueprints in "No door plan at workbench" (Aug 4): rllewis3 found that workbench pages can be dragged back and forth with the left mouse button, which revealed plans that seemed missing; jw62157 (the thread author) realized that clicking the arrow keys at the top slides the choices over but often hides some blueprints behind the left panel that keeps opening.

sections.heading: Symptom B: no roof, door or bed blueprint at the workbench (UI scrolling)
sections.text: Practical takeaway: use slow mouse-wheel scrolling or left-mouse dragging to page the workbench list, and be careful with the top arrow buttons — they can leave blueprints hidden behind the side panel.

sections.heading: Symptom C: cannot build a door
sections.text: One player, Earth Hunter (in "No door plan at workbench" , Aug 4), reports that the blueprint list contains two door types — an exterior door and an interior door — and that you also need a wall with a door opening for the door to fit. This is a single community report, not officially confirmed, but it matches the building system's wall-cutout logic and is worth checking before reporting a bug.

sections.heading: Symptom D: hole in the middle of the roof (Roof Cap Lvl 2)
sections.text: Single report unverified

sections.heading: Symptom D: hole in the middle of the roof (Roof Cap Lvl 2)
sections.text: Several players use Roof Cap Lvl 2 to fill the hole in the middle and then wonder whether that counts. One player, bucfanjoe (in "Cant finish Roof quest...?" , Aug 3), reports that their own build moved past the roof step even with a hole in the middle, as long as the exterior edges had a roof tile — but notes being unsure whether Lvl 2 caps count, and adds that having actual doors and windows placed in the wall cutouts may matter. Treat this as a single unverified report: if Symptom A's fixes fail, completing the

sections.heading: Troubleshooting flow (our consolidated checklist)
sections.text: Work through these in order — each step rules out one of the symptoms above:

sections.heading: Troubleshooting flow (our consolidated checklist)
sections.text: Can you find the blueprint at all? If no roof/door/bed plan appears at the workbench, fix the UI first: slow mouse-wheel scroll, left-mouse drag, avoid the top arrows hiding plans behind the side panel ( Symptom B ).

sections.heading: Troubleshooting flow (our consolidated checklist)
sections.text: Is the building actually complete? Walls placed, wall with a door opening for the door, exterior and interior door types distinguished ( Symptom C ), roof tiles on all exterior edges ( Symptom D ).

sections.heading: Troubleshooting flow (our consolidated checklist)
sections.text: Is the tracker stuck? Building done but the quest will not advance → press T and check the phone quest journal, sleep to the next day, then restart the client ( Symptom A , officially confirmed known issue).

sections.heading: Troubleshooting flow (our consolidated checklist)
sections.text: Still stuck after all three? Report it on the Steam discussion board with your build version and screenshots — the developers are actively investigating the tracker issue.

sections.heading: Roof quest FAQ
sections.text: I built the roof exactly as shown. Why won't the quest complete?

sections.heading: Roof quest FAQ
sections.text: Most likely the quest tracker is stuck — an officially confirmed known issue in Early Access. Press T to check the phone quest journal (the next step may already be there), sleep to the next day, or restart the client. These workarounds have worked for almost every player so far, per the support team.

sections.heading: Roof quest FAQ
sections.text: There are no roof or bed blueprints in my workbench. Is my save broken?

sections.heading: Roof quest FAQ
sections.text: Probably not. Multiple players "missing" roofs, beds and doors were actually hitting a scrolling UI quirk: the plans sit far right in the building tab, fast scrolling overshoots into the furniture tab, and the top arrow buttons can hide plans behind the left panel. Scroll slowly with the mouse wheel or drag the pages with the left mouse button.

sections.heading: Roof quest FAQ
sections.text: Does a Roof Cap Lvl 2 hole in the middle block the quest?

sections.heading: Roof quest FAQ
sections.text: Unknown. One player reports progressing with a hole in the middle as long as exterior edges had roof tiles, but was unsure whether Lvl 2 caps count — a single unverified report. If the official tracker fixes fail, edging the roof and fitting doors/windows into wall cutouts is a sensible next test.

If no roof/door/bed plan appears at the workbench, fix the UI first: slow mouse-wheel scroll, left-mouse drag, avoid the top arrows hiding plans behind the side panel ( Symptom B ). Is the building actually complete? Walls placed, wall with a door opening for the door, exterior and interior door types distinguished ( Symptom C ), roof tiles on all exterior edges ( Symptom D ). Is the tracker stuck? Building done but the quest will not advance → press T and check the phone quest journal, sleep to the next day, then restart the client ( Symptom A , officially confirmed known issue). Still stuck after all three? Report it on the Steam discussion board with your build version and screenshots — the developers are actively investigating the tracker issue.

title: Roof quest FAQ
parentTitle: Roof Quest Stuck in The Ranchers? Building Quest Fixes That Work
description: I built the roof exactly as shown. Why won't the quest complete? Most likely the quest tracker is stuck — an officially confirmed known issue in Early Access. Press T to check the phone quest journal (the next step may already be there), sleep to the next day, or restart the client. These workarounds have worked for almost every player so far, per the support team. There are no roof or bed blueprints in my workbench. Is my save broken? Probably not. Multiple players "missing" roofs, beds and doors were actually hitting a scrolling UI quirk: the plans sit far right in the building tab, fast scrolling overshoots into the furniture tab, and the top arrow buttons can hide plans behind the left panel. Scroll slowly with the mouse wheel or drag the pages with the left mouse button. Does a Roof Cap Lvl 2 hole in the middle block the quest? Unknown. One player reports progressing with a hole in the middle as long as exterior edges had roof tiles, but was unsure whether Lvl 2 caps count — a single unverified report. If the official tracker fixes fail, edging the roof and fitting doors/windows into wall cutouts is a sensible next test.

title: Real Eggs, Real Evidence: Gigi Quest Walkthrough (The Ranchers)
description: The Ranchers Gigi quest walkthrough: get 2 large eggs by raising chicken ratings, take the subway (not a car) for the police chase, follow the mini-map star to her house, and what to do when Gigi keeps following you or the quest disappears.

sections.heading: Real Eggs, Real Evidence: Gigi Quest Walkthrough (The Ranchers)
sections.text: Updated for Early Access 0.8.10.842 · August 22, 2026 · Reading time: ~8 min

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: One-sentence version of the quest: pet your chickens daily until their rating rises and they lay 2 large eggs, manually save, then take the subway — not a car — to hand the eggs over, escape the police on foot, and follow the mini-map star marker all the way to Gigi's front door to finish.

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: The two most common failure points: players never get large eggs because they do not raise the chickens' rating ( step 1 ), and the final hand-in bugs out if you drive or if Gigi will not leave your car ( step 4 ). Yes, the quest is completable in Early Access — and no, Gigi not contacting you afterwards matches what other players see — multiple players report no further quest has appeared in the current build ( details ).

sections.heading: Step 1: getting 2 large eggs
sections.text: The quest needs 2 large eggs , and regular eggs do not count — Bobthekiller's exact blocker in "Real eggs, real evidence" (Aug 4, 2026) was only ever receiving regular eggs. DJM's answer in the same thread: pet the chickens every day; when their rating goes up, they start laying larger eggs , and once you have 2, the quest shows you where to take them. So if you never see large eggs, the fix is daily petting to raise the rating, not more hens.

sections.heading: Egg fertility and the "Infertile" label
sections.text: Hotfix 0.8.10.562 also replaced the egg label "Failed to hatch" with "Infertile" for clarity — an official confirmation that a fertility/hatching mechanic exists in the current build. We have not re-tested hatching details on the current build (rates, incubation conditions), so nothing beyond the label change is claimed here. sections.heading: Step 2–3: handing over the eggs and escaping the police
sections.text: Handing over the eggs triggers a police chase, and three independent players give the same advice: take the subway to the hand-in, do not drive (Seansniper27 — "went in by subway and not car, found out the hard way"; bucfanjoe; Fight or Flight Gamer). A car chase with the starter vehicle is where most failed attempts happen.

sections.heading: Step 2–3: handing over the eggs and escaping the police
sections.text: For escaping on foot, bucfanjoe describes a route that worked ( "Large Egg Quest Gone" , Aug 3): run for the river — it usually shakes the drones — then continue under the ferris wheel and up toward the museum until the police lose you, then let Gigi catch up. Seansniper27 adds that the next objective can point you to her house, back to the hand-in spot, or somewhere in between — watch the tracker rather than assuming one fixed destination.

WildW0lf, whose car was impounded mid-quest, could never get Gigi back into a car and had to abandon the quest.

sections.heading: Stuck point: Gigi keeps following you and will not leave
sections.text: One detailed working route comes from Fight or Flight Gamer (in this thread ): after the on-foot escape, talking to Gigi only repeated her egg line — but the mini-map showed a mission star marker that the big map did not . Following the mini-map star on foot, with Gigi following, led to her house — and only once at her front door did she become available to talk to, which cleared the quest. sections.heading: If the quest disappears after failing
sections.text: Reports conflict here. AlterEgoGenral believes a failed quest can simply be retaken, but aes1218 ( "Large Egg Quest Gone" , Aug 3) failed the escape twice and reports the quest disappearing entirely, with no found way to re-trigger it. Whether a failed Gigi quest can always be re-accepted is currently Unknown. Our site recommendation: make a manual save before handing over the eggs , so a failed escape costs you a reload instead of the quest line. sections.heading: Gigi quest FAQ

sections.heading: Gigi quest FAQ
sections.text: Check the mini-map for a mission star marker — it can appear there while staying absent from the big map. Walk (do not drive) to that star, which is her house; she only becomes interactable at her front door. sections.text: Probably not. Multiple players report that no further quest has appeared after "Real Eggs, Real Evidence" in the current Early Access build — players waited into Summer and Autumn with no follow-up. We treat the line as ending here unless official notes or new reports show otherwise.

sections.heading: Forgetting to harvest & when seeds disappear
sections.text: The developers' last pre-launch mechanics update, "Bigger, better and truly next level!" (Dec 2, 2025), states the new plantation rules directly:

sections.heading: Forgetting to harvest & when seeds disappear
sections.text: Seeds only disappear when the plant dies. A planted seed is not consumed by harvesting or by time alone.

sections.heading: Forgetting to harvest & when seeds disappear
sections.text: Fruits and vegetables no longer get destroyed if you forget to harvest them. Ripe produce waits on the plant instead of rotting away.

sections.heading: Forgetting to harvest & when seeds disappear
sections.text: A simpler, more intuitive re-grow flow for recurring crops.

sections.heading: Forgetting to harvest & when seeds disappear
sections.text: Because this wording comes from an official update and no later patch note (through 0.8.10.842) contradicts it, we treat these as the working rules — with the explicit caveat that they were announced before Early Access launch and we have not yet re-verified each line in-game on the current build.

sections.heading: Season-change crop loss: current reports, exact cutoff unverified
sections.text: Current-build reports

sections.heading: Season-change crop loss: current reports, exact cutoff unverified
sections.text: Two current-build threads report crops disappearing around a season boundary, but they do not independently establish every calendar detail. In "WTF ?? A whole field of eggplants gone after sleeping ???" (Aug 3, 2026), the poster lost an entire eggplant field overnight; player Mancer explained that day 30 is the last harvest day, day 1 begins the new season, and seasonal crops are removed during the rollover. FIDELIS reported disappearing eggplants in "Things disappear" (Aug 6), but that report alone does not verif

sections.heading: Season-change crop loss: current reports, exact cutoff unverified
sections.text: Mancer's season-seed list from the same thread is a single community report, so treat it as a working reference, not gospel: summer — green lettuce, eggplant, corn; spring — strawberries, garlic, green salad; autumn — onions, carrots, pumpkins. Our own video-observed data confirms strawberry as a spring seed and red lettuce with a spring tag on build 0.8.10.455 (see the crop database ).

sections.heading: Season-change crop loss: current reports, exact cutoff unverified
sections.text: Practical takeaway: check the calendar before a big planting run late in a season — seeds planted on day 28 of a season may never reach their first harvest.

sections.heading: Regrow vs one-time crops
sections.text: Video-observed recorded on build 0.8.10.455

sections.heading: Regrow vs one-time crops
sections.text: Retained gameplay footage of the launch build shows the two crop archetypes side by side:

sections.heading: Regrow vs one-time crops
sections.text: Strawberry Seeds (144C): spring seed, first harvest 7 days after planting, then re-harvests every 3 days — a recurring crop.

sections.heading: Regrow vs one-time crops
sections.text: Red Lettuce Seeds (48C): spring seed, matures in 3 days with no regrow line on the seed description — a one-time crop you replant.

sections.heading: Regrow vs one-time crops
sections.text: The official pre-EA update's "simpler re-grow flow for recurring crops" Official matches this split: recurring crops keep their plant and cycle again, one-time crops are replanted from new seeds. Exact regrow intervals for other crops are still being collected — the crop database tracks each one with its own evidence label.

sections.heading: Removing a field plot and watering: what is known

title: Forgetting to harvest & when seeds disappear
parentTitle: Farming & Fields in The Ranchers: Watering, Harvest, Regrow and Fertilizer Rules
description: Official pre-Early-Access update (Dec 2, 2025), mechanism assumed live but not yet re-tested on 0.8.10.842 The developers' last pre-launch mechanics update, "Bigger, better and truly next level!" (Dec 2, 2025), states the new plantation rules directly: Seeds only disappear when the plant dies. A planted seed is not consumed by harvesting or by time alone. Fruits and vegetables no longer get destroyed if you forget to harvest them. Ripe produce waits on the plant instead of rotting away. A simpler, more intuitive re-grow flow for recurring crops. Because this wording comes from an official update and no later patch note (through 0.8.10.842) contradicts it, we treat these as the working rules — with the explicit caveat that they were announced before Early Access launch and we have not yet re-verified each line in-game on the current build.

title: Season-change crop loss: current reports, exact cutoff unverified
parentTitle: Farming & Fields in The Ranchers: Watering, Harvest, Regrow and Fertilizer Rules
description: Current-build reports Two current-build threads report crops disappearing around a season boundary, but they do not independently establish every calendar detail. In "WTF ?? A whole field of eggplants gone after sleeping ???" (Aug 3, 2026), the poster lost an entire eggplant field overnight; player Mancer explained that day 30 is the last harvest day, day 1 begins the new season, and seasonal crops are removed during the rollover. FIDELIS reported disappearing eggplants in "Things disappear" (Aug 6), but that report alone does not verif Mancer's season-seed list from the same thread is a single community report, so treat it as a working reference, not gospel: summer — green lettuce, eggplant, corn; spring — strawberries, garlic, green salad; autumn — onions, carrots, pumpkins. Our own video-observed data confirms strawberry as a spring seed and red lettuce with a spring tag on build 0.8.10.455 (see the crop database ). Practical takeaway: check the calendar before a big planting run late in a season — seeds planted on day 28 of a season may never reach their first harvest.

title: Regrow vs one-time crops
parentTitle: Farming & Fields in The Ranchers: Watering, Harvest, Regrow and Fertilizer Rules
description: Video-observed recorded on build 0.8.10.455 Retained gameplay footage of the launch build shows the two crop archetypes side by side: Strawberry Seeds (144C): spring seed, first harvest 7 days after planting, then re-harvests every 3 days — a recurring crop. Red Lettuce Seeds (48C): spring seed, matures in 3 days with no regrow line on the seed description — a one-time crop you replant. The official pre-EA update's "simpler re-grow flow for recurring crops" Official matches this split: recurring crops keep their plant and cycle again, one-time crops are replanted from new seeds. Exact regrow intervals for other crops are still being collected — the crop database tracks each one with its own evidence label.

Current-build players also report crop loss around season changes; one reply gives day 30 → day 1 as the cutoff, but that exact timing still needs reproduction. The cautious move is to finish seasonal harvests before rollover. Is fertilizer worth buying? The Aug 4 support warning said fertilizer was calculating incorrectly and advised players to avoid investing until it was adjusted. The 0.8.10.842 notes did not announce a fix, but we have not re-tested the item on that current build. Avoid a large purchase until current evidence confirms its return. How do I make a new field, and how do I get a greenhouse? Both are on hold. The only tilling walkthroughs are from the 2022 Alpha, and the only greenhouse unlock reference (blueprint from Lina) is from November 2022 — neither is verified for the current build. We have published the exact verification steps in the hold section instead of guessing.

sections.text: A useful resource report needs more than “I found it.” Record the named build, platform, owned or unowned land, season or day, exact object searched, quantity before and after, and a screenshot of the inventory or shop screen. If another player can repeat the same result under comparable conditions, the site can promote the lead from a report to a corroborated finding.

This is the part you can act on now. A single current-build report suggests cutting bushes or searching crates and barrels on NPC farms. It is useful as a test route, but it is not a guaranteed drop table. Record the location, container, build and whether the item was actually Hay before treating it as corroborated. title: Charcoal: a lead to test, not a recipe
parentTitle: The Ranchers Resources & Items — Shops, Food & Materials
description: A community scan describes a possible loop of burning Wood Logs, waiting for a material change, then using a fire extinguisher before collecting Charcoal. The retained record has no direct public post URL and no current screenshot, so this page does not present it as a confirmed recipe. If you test it, use one log first. Record the exact object, ignition method, elapsed time, fire state, extinguisher action and resulting inventory. Do not burn a full reserve based on the old Alpha context; the historical moderator answer only confirms the extinguisher as the intended way to put out fires. title: Resource FAQ
parentTitle: The Ranchers Resources & Items — Shops, Food & Materials
description: Can I mine Stone or Zirconite right now? Do not assume it. The current official answer says mines are not available in the reviewed build; Stone should start with loose pieces on owned land, while Zirconite should be purchased. Is the Charcoal burning method confirmed? No. It is a community lead with historical fire-extinguisher context. Test it with one log and record the result before relying on it. Where do I continue from here? Use the materials database for individual evidence records, the crafting guide to inspect plans and requirements, the building guide for placement context, or the animal guide when the material is feed. Maintenance note: This guide is an unofficial fan resource and is not affiliated with RedPilz Studio or Trophy Games. Values and routes may change during Early Access; the page keeps older evidence labeled rather than silently replacing it. Read the evidence method .

title: The Ranchers Controls & Camera Settings Guide
description: The Ranchers controls and camera settings explained: right-mouse camera rotation, left-mouse tool actions, one-button hammer placement, ESC menu, every camera recenter and zoom option with its default, QWERTZ support, and motion-sickness tips.

sections.heading: The Ranchers Controls & Camera Settings Guide
sections.text: Updated for Early Access 0.8.10.x (August 2026) · August 7, 2026 · Reading time: ~6 min

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: The Ranchers controls were simplified in an official update: Right Mouse Button rotates the camera, Left Mouse Button performs all primary tool actions, and building placement with the Hammer now needs only one button . Open the menu with ESC — Game Settings, including the full Camera Settings section, are accessible directly from it. Every default value and its source update is listed below.

sections.heading: Controls quick reference
sections.text: Official Day rollover is manual. Per the pre-EA Ranching v2 update notes, a new day starts only when you press the "Start new day" button in the end-of-the-day summary — the notes explicitly call this the way to pause the game, and say it works in multiplayer too. Caveat: this is pre-EA official documentation , not yet independently rechecked in the current EA build. If you need a break mid-day, use sleep to reach the summary screen and simply do not press the button until you are ready.

sections.heading: Building controls
sections.text: Official (Feb 2026 update, demo-era); recheck against the current EA build. Two options were added for builders:

sections.heading: Building controls
sections.text: Auto Equip Hammer after placement — default ON. The Hammer stays in your hands after placing a blueprint, so chaining multiple placements does not require re-equipping.

sections.heading: Building controls
sections.text: Auto Re-Equip Same Blueprint after placement — default OFF. Enable this if you are placing many copies of the same piece.

sections.heading: Building controls
sections.text: The same update added clearer error messages when placing blueprints — for unpurchased farm parcels, unauthorized zones or interiors, collisions or failed placement requirements, and exceeding City Hall building height limits. If placement fails, read the message before assuming a bug; see the Building & Placement Guide and the roof quest troubleshooting page for the most common blockers.

sections.heading: Motion sickness: settings that help
sections.text: Editorial The suggestions in this section are our editorial recommendations, built on the official settings above — they are not official prescriptions.

sections.heading: Motion sickness: settings that help
sections.text: Adjust Automatic Camera Recentering Latency first. The official notes explicitly say this setting (default 0.5 s) helps with motion sickness — a lower value recenters the camera faster.

sections.heading: Motion sickness: settings that help
sections.text: Keep Auto Reset Camera Zoom disabled (the default) so the frame stays stable while driving instead of zooming on context changes.

sections.heading: Motion sickness: settings that help
sections.text: Decide on recentering deliberately. If automatic camera movement bothers you, disable Automatic Camera Recenter – In Vehicle; if fighting the camera manually is what tires you, enable the on-foot recenter instead.

sections.heading: Motion sickness: settings that help
sections.text: Lower Camera Movement Speed if fast panning is what triggers discomfort — the post-update camera already has reduced acceleration and deceleration, so small slider changes go a long way.

sections.heading: Controls FAQ
sections.text: How do I rotate the camera in The Ranchers?

sections.heading: Controls FAQ
sections.text: Hold the Right Mouse Button, per the official control simplification update (Feb 2026, demo-era — recheck against the current EA build). All primary tool actions moved to the Left Mouse Button at the same time.

sections.heading: Controls FAQ
sections.text: Where are the camera settings?

sections.heading: Controls FAQ
sections.text: Open the menu with ESC — Game Settings are accessible directly from the ESC menu — and look for the dedicated Camera Settings section added in the Feb 2026 update (demo-era; recheck against the current EA build).

sections.heading: Controls FAQ
sections.text: Does the game pause when I open Settings?

sections.heading: Controls FAQ
sections.text: In solo mode, yes — the official notes say the game pauses while you use the Feedback App or Settings App (Feb 2026 update, demo-era; recheck against the current EA build). Do not rely on pausing in a co-op session.

sections.heading: Controls FAQ
sections.text: Is there QWERTZ keyboard support?

sections.heading: Controls FAQ
sections.text: Yes — QWERTZ layout support (Germany, Austria, etc.) was added in the official Feb 2026 update (demo-era; recheck against the current EA build).

sections.heading: Controls FAQ
sections.text: The camera keeps swinging back while I drive. Can I stop it?

sections.heading: Controls FAQ
sections.text: That is Automatic Camera Recenter – In Vehicle, which is enabled by default. Disable it in Camera Settings, or raise the recentering latency (default 0.5 s) so it kicks in more slowly.

sections.heading: How to build a trustworthy crop row
sections.text: Record the game version, season, seed source, seed cost, planting day, harvest day, yield per plot, sale destination, sale price, and any quality or processing modifier. Use a control plot without bonuses, measure occupied days (not only the printed growth time), separate sale channels, and repeat the test at least once. The full verification workflow is on the methodology page .

title: Strawberry
description: Database record: Back to entries fruit Strawberry Updated 2026-08-08 The first video-confirmed regrow crop: 144C seed, Spring, 7 days to first harvest, then fruit every 3 days. Berry sell price is unobserved — the 18C-per-harvest figure is a cost-allocation model, not revenue. Game-build configuration · 0.8.10.842 Seed item Strawberry Seed Season Spring First harvest 7 days Regrow interval 3 days Dry tolerance 2 days Seed-shop table View shop configuration File configuration, not individually gameplay-tested. A shop-table match does not guarantee current availability. Source and comparison table Seed item settings Editor-collected game-file settings: Farming classification, Bronze rarity, right-hand slot, equip/stack/drop/sell flags enabled, and Energy consumption 1 / restoration 0. Internal prices are withheld; I2 description slots are empty. Produce item settings Names come from the original I2 text. Health/Energy restoration values are game-file settings, not tested safe-to-eat or runtime-effect claims. Strawberry — Normal configuration · Health restore 32 · Energy restore 120 Shop configuration 1 Giant Strawberry — Giant configuration · Health restore 53 · Energy restore 140 All use Farming classification, Bronze rarity, a both-hands slot, and enabled equip/stack/drop/sell flags. Shop references do not guarantee current stock; internal prices are not retail or player-sale values. Seed source & price Strawberry Seed is sold in the Leafy Market "Seed & Fertilizer" tab at 144C (Basic quality); the purchase dialog separately confirmed 10 seeds = 1,440C. Video-observed Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57) The historical Alpha record listed Strawberry Seeds at 38C — superseded by the current-build 144C observation; kept as a lead only. Historical Farmer's Land — community-maintained player wiki page (Alpha build) Growth & regrow Season: Spring · Growth time: 7 days · Multi-harvest: every 3 days (regrows after the first harvest). Video-observed Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57) The historical Alpha record claimed daily fruiting after maturity with 10-20 berries per plot and a 20C sale value — Alpha data, not confirmed in the current build. Historical Farmer's Land — community-maintained player wiki page (Alpha build) Sell price (player) vs retail Theoretical model (our derivation, not an observed outcome): seed-cost allocation ≈ 18C per harvest, assuming eight harvests in a full 30-day Spring (day 7, then days 10, 13, 16, 19, 22, 25, 28) with no missed regrowth, no season-boundary loss and no plant death. Profit/day = (sell price × yield − allocated seed cost) ÷ 3 — open until a sell price is captured. Single-source Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57) 1 item not yet verified — show Player sell price per berry: unknown — never observed on screen, and the daily settlement does not break crop income down per crop. Unknown Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)

sections.heading: First animal: a practical care path
sections.text: Chicken is the only animal with a broadly documented current-build care loop. Use this order before comparing prices or chasing production numbers:

sections.heading: First animal: a practical care path
sections.text: Finish the purchase prompt with Angela, then bring the chickens home from the fenced area behind her house.

sections.heading: First animal: a practical care path
sections.text: Link the coop and fill the indoor trough with hay and water. The outdoor trough is not required for ordinary daily feeding.

sections.heading: First animal: a practical care path
sections.text: Install the coop-specific heater from Angela on the coop exterior wall; a household decoration heater is not a substitute.

sections.heading: First animal: a practical care path
sections.text: For large eggs, keep needs and satisfaction high, pet the chickens, and provide an enclosed outdoor roaming area. This improves the chance; it does not guarantee the next egg is large.

sections.heading: First animal: a practical care path
sections.text: If an animal disappears, update to 0.8.10.842 or later first, then use the current troubleshooting checklist rather than an older workaround.

sections.heading: First animal: a practical care path
sections.text: Collect discoveries privately in Field Notes , then export the versioned record when it is complete enough to verify.

sections.heading: First animal: a practical care path
sections.text: This living database combines the official roster with clearly labeled player research. Each animal has its own anchored profile below — search an individual animal, inspect its source and version context, and help replace historical values with current-build evidence.

sections.heading: First animal: a practical care path
sections.text: The best-documented animal in the current build. Buy from Angela, keep hay and water in the coop trough, mount the coop heater on the outside wall, and pet daily for a shot at large eggs.

sections.heading: Buying & bringing home
sections.text: Buy chickens from Angela, the chicken seller NPC. After purchase they do not enter your backpack — they appear in the small fenced field behind her house. Grab them manually: carry them home one by one on foot, or load them into a car boot. Community-confirmed Steam thread "Chicken coop mission" (DJM, Yakiwi)

sections.heading: Buying & bringing home
sections.text: In every documented case the coop-mission stuck point came from missing the post-purchase prompt; other bugs in this mission cannot be ruled out. Community-confirmed Steam thread "Chicken coop mission" (DJM, Yakiwi) · Community discussion scan archive (local file: community-scan-2026-08-08.md, 90 topics scanned, 44 read)

sections.heading: Housing & heater
sections.text: Chickens live in a coop. The heater and AC must be the coop/barn versions bought from Angela — the house decoration heater/AC sold at City Hall does nothing for coops. Official Steam thread "Big Chicken Eggs" (Jennoula, official)

sections.heading: Housing & heater
sections.text: Mount the coop heater on the outside of the coop exterior wall. Official Steam thread "Big Chicken Eggs" (Jennoula, official)

sections.heading: Housing & heater
sections.text: A fenced outdoor roaming area matters: chickens that can roam outside in an enclosed area get the chance to lay large eggs. Official Steam thread "About the chickens" (Jennoula, official)

sections.heading: Housing & heater
sections.text: Chicks exist as the early growth stage of chickens; 2 additional rooster variations were added. Official · pre-EA documented The Ranchers, Ranching v2 update! (official Steam announcement)

sections.heading: Feeding
sections.text: Chickens eat hay — they pick the grains out of hay/straw piles. Official Steam thread "Chicken Feed" (Jennoula, official)

sections.heading: Feeding
sections.text: Two ways to feed: hold hay near the animal to hand-feed (raises the food reserve bar in its info tab), or fill the trough and animals eat by themselves once every morning, covering the whole day. Official Steam thread "Food and water reserves" (Mancer, Jennoula)

sections.heading: Feeding
sections.text: General daily care: only the trough inside the coop needs filling — animals eat and drink inside before leaving in the morning, so outdoor troughs stay optional while the door is open. Official Steam thread "About the chickens" (Jennoula, official)

sections.heading: Feeding
sections.text: Hay comes from cutting bushes or looting crates and barrels on NPC farms. Single-source Steam thread "where can i find hay" (Tila)

sections.heading: Water
sections.text: Water is supplied through a trough; hand-feeding does not work for water — the water reserve bar only refills from a trough. Official Steam thread "Food and water reserves" (Mancer, Jennoula)

sections.heading: Water
sections.text: For automated water, a water tower alone is not enough — you must sign a water contract with the mayor at City Hall, then the tower refills on its own. Community-confirmed Steam thread "Watertower problem" (Akhenatom, Mancer, Jennoula) · Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, shelf scan 03:15–03:45)

sections.heading: Eggs & meat
sections.text: Adult chickens with every need and satisfaction maxed start laying. Egg size (S/M/L) and whether an egg is fertile are RNG; hover an egg to check fertility. Large eggs are the rarest and require maxed needs plus happiness. Official Steam thread "Egg Hatching Question" (Jennoula, official; SUwUMaBUwU)

sections.heading: Eggs & meat
sections.text: Chicken Egg - Small retails at 60C on the Leafy Market shelf. This is a shop purchase price, not what your eggs sell for. Video-observed Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, shelf scan 03:15–03:45)

sections.heading: Breeding & hatching

sections.heading: Sickness & the vet
sections.text: An animal sickness mechanic exists; the heater prevents temperature sickness but cannot cure an already sick animal. Official Steam thread "Big Chicken Eggs" (Jennoula, official) · The Ranchers, Ranching v2 update! (official Steam announcement)

sections.heading: Sickness & the vet
sections.text: Take sick chickens to the veterinarian. The vet only treats animals that are actually sick — a famished (starving) animal is turned away. Single-source Steam thread "how to cure at the vet?" (Seansniper27, maxitubby)

sections.heading: Sickness & the vet
sections.text: A famished chicken recovers by the next morning if you bring it back to the coop and feed it manually. Single-source Steam thread "how to cure at the vet?" (Seansniper27, maxitubby)

sections.heading: Sickness & the vet
sections.text: There is no sickness notification system; check animals manually each day. Single-source Community discussion scan archive (local file: community-scan-2026-08-08.md, 90 topics scanned, 44 read)

sections.heading: Feed automation chain
sections.text: Full chain: mount an Auto-Feeding Kit on the coop, build a Silo inside its range and load hay, build a Water Tower (its link radius is much smaller than the silo's), sign the water contract with the mayor, then pick food/water type on the coop trough and flip the switch — a green light confirms a correct setup. Official Steam thread "Does the automatic barn feeding kit work?" (gamingmarcel20, Jennoula) · Steam thread "Silos" (maxitubby, Jennoula) · Steam thread "Watertower problem" (Akhenatom, Mancer, Jennoula)

sections.heading: Feed automation chain
sections.text: Hovering buildings with the hammer equipped shows linkage; a silo displays how many auto-feeders connect to it, and linking happens automatically. Single-source Steam thread "Silos" (maxitubby, Jennoula)

sections.heading: Feed automation chain
sections.text: The water meter is on the phone, or on the wall at the far right end past the ranch gate. Single-source Steam thread "Watertower problem" (Akhenatom, Mancer, Jennoula)

sections.heading: Feed automation chain
sections.text: Most "auto feeder does nothing" reports trace back to a missing water contract or the water tower sitting outside link radius. Community-confirmed Steam thread "Does the automatic barn feeding kit work?" (gamingmarcel20, Jennoula) · Community discussion scan archive (local file: community-scan-2026-08-08.md, 90 topics scanned, 44 read)

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: The Gigi large-egg quest needs large eggs: pet chickens daily to raise their rating and use the Angela heater. Two large eggs are needed before the delivery point appears. Community-confirmed Steam thread on the Gigi egg quest (DJM, Bobthekiller and others)

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: Daily care needs only the trough inside the coop — animals eat and drink there before leaving in the morning (official). What an outdoor area affects is large-egg chance: chickens that roam outside in an enclosed area get the chance to lay large eggs. There is no evidence that the Gigi quest requires an outdoor trough. Official Steam thread "About the chickens" (Jennoula, official)

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: The chicken coop mission has no confirmed bug — bought chickens wait in the field behind Angela's house, and documented stuck cases trace back to the missed prompt. Community-confirmed Steam thread "Chicken coop mission" (DJM, Yakiwi)

sections.heading: Disappearing-chicken checklist
sections.text: Hotfix 0.8.10.562 officially fixed several animal disappearance paths: entering a barn or coop at night, chicks growing up, newborn mammals spawning, animals appearing after a load, and animals becoming stuck between a barn or coop and its doors. This remains the historical fix boundary; current residual reports should be tested on 0.8.10.842 or later. Official · pre-EA documented Hotfix 0.8.10.562 — official Steam announcement

sections.heading: Disappearing-chicken checklist
sections.text: The 0.8.10.842 update adds animal edge-case fixes for barn/coop association, growth-stage state, hunger display, linked counts, repeated turning at doors and a same-frame disappearance case. Official 0.8.10.842 update — official Steam announcement

sections.heading: Disappearing-chicken checklist
sections.text: Before 0.8.10.562, chickens submitted at the coop door could enter the stock count but vanish or get stuck inside the coop's exterior wall. The historical workaround was to walk inside before dropping them; stuck birds could sometimes be recovered by removing the others and demolishing the coop. Historical Steam thread on the coop-door chicken delivery bug (Big Grizzly) · Steam thread "Hühnerstall Bug" (Kartesk, Jennoula) · Hotfix 0.8.10.562 — official Steam announcement

sections.heading: Disappearing-chicken checklist
sections.text: Check linking first: walking near the door should show a stock counter like 0/6 over the dark floor area — no counter means the coop is not linked. Official Steam thread "Hühnerstall Bug" (Kartesk, Jennoula)

sections.heading: Disappearing-chicken checklist
sections.text: Before treating a missing chicken as a bug, the official moderator checklist is to verify the coop linked count, whether the door opens into a fully enclosed fence, any daily report notices, and green dots anywhere on the full map. These observations narrow the cause; none alone proves player error or a game bug. Official Steam thread: missing-chicken troubleshooting checklist

sections.heading: Disappearing-chicken checklist
sections.text: No fence plus an open door lets chickens wander off for good. Community-confirmed Community discussion scan archive (local file: community-scan-2026-08-08.md, 90 topics scanned, 44 read)

sections.heading: Disappearing-chicken checklist
sections.text: Without the Angela heater/AC, chickens die from heat or cold stress. Community-confirmed Steam thread "Animals keep dying" (multiple players)

sections.heading: Disappearing-chicken checklist
sections.text: Before 0.8.10.562, one player reported that reloading the save sometimes respawned a vanished chicken. Historical Steam thread "A temp chicken issue fix!" (LittleGhost and others)

sections.heading: Selling & profit
sections.text: Selling live animals is not implemented. The official recommendation for surplus chickens and roosters is to dispatch them with an axe, pickaxe or weapon and sell the meat. The animal must be placed on the ground first — tools do not work while carrying it (that is intended, not a bug). Official Steam thread "Can't sell roosters" (Jennoula, official)

sections.heading: Selling & profit
sections.text: One detailed profit report values an adult (10+ days) Legendary chicken at roughly 24,000C in meat (1× 9,000 meat + 2× 500 legs + 8× 1,750 breasts), with Legendary eggs at S 250 / M 375 / L 590; a second player puts an ordinary mature chicken at 5,000+C of meat. Single-source numbers — meat out-earning eggs is the corroborated direction, the figures are not. Single-source Steam thread "Livestock profit" (Numinex, BeBeForever16)

title: First animal: a practical care path
parentTitle: The Ranchers Animal Database — Confirmed Roster & Data Tracker
description: Chicken is the only animal with a broadly documented current-build care loop. Use this order before comparing prices or chasing production numbers: Finish the purchase prompt with Angela, then bring the chickens home from the fenced area behind her house. Link the coop and fill the indoor trough with hay and water. The outdoor trough is not required for ordinary daily feeding. Install the coop-specific heater from Angela on the coop exterior wall; a household decoration heater is not a substitute. For large eggs, keep needs and satisfaction high, pet the chickens, and provide an enclosed outdoor roaming area. This improves the chance; it does not guarantee the next egg is large. If an animal disappears, update to 0.8.10.842 or later first, then use the current troubleshooting checklist rather than an older workaround. Collect discoveries privately in Field Notes , then export the versioned record when it is complete enough to verify. This living database combines the official roster with clearly labeled player research. Each animal has its own anchored profile below — search an individual animal, inspect its source and version context, and help replace historical values with current-build evidence. The best-documented animal in the current build. Buy from Angela, keep hay and water in the coop trough, mount the coop heater on the outside wall, and pet daily for a shot at large eggs.

title: Feeding
parentTitle: The Ranchers Animal Database — Confirmed Roster & Data Tracker
description: Chickens eat hay — they pick the grains out of hay/straw piles. Official Steam thread "Chicken Feed" (Jennoula, official) Two ways to feed: hold hay near the animal to hand-feed (raises the food reserve bar in its info tab), or fill the trough and animals eat by themselves once every morning, covering the whole day. Official Steam thread "Food and water reserves" (Mancer, Jennoula) General daily care: only the trough inside the coop needs filling — animals eat and drink inside before leaving in the morning, so outdoor troughs stay optional while the door is open. title: Disappearing-chicken checklist
parentTitle: The Ranchers Animal Database — Confirmed Roster & Data Tracker
description: Hotfix 0.8.10.562 officially fixed several animal disappearance paths: entering a barn or coop at night, chicks growing up, newborn mammals spawning, animals appearing after a load, and animals becoming stuck between a barn or coop and its doors. This remains the historical fix boundary; current residual reports should be tested on 0.8.10.842 or later. Official · pre-EA documented Hotfix 0.8.10.562 — official Steam announcement The 0.8.10.842 update adds animal edge-case fixes for barn/coop association, growth-stage state, hunger display, linked counts, repeated turning at doors and a same-frame disappearance case. Official 0.8.10.842 update — official Steam announcement Before 0.8.10.562, chickens submitted at the coop door could enter the stock count but vanish or get stuck inside the coop's exterior wall. The historical workaround was to walk inside before dropping them; stuck birds could sometimes be recovered by removing the others and demolishing the coop. Historical Steam thread on the coop-door chicken delivery bug (Big Grizzly) · Steam thread "Hühnerstall Bug" (Kartesk, Jennoula) · Hotfix 0.8.10.562 — official Steam announcement Check linking first: walking near the door should show a stock counter like 0/6 over the dark floor area — no counter means the coop is not linked. Official Steam thread "Hühnerstall Bug" (Kartesk, Jennoula) Before treating a missing chicken as a bug, the official moderator checklist is to verify the coop linked count, whether the door opens into a fully enclosed fence, any daily report notices, and green dots anywhere on the full map. These observations narrow the cause; none alone proves player error or a game bug. Official Steam thread: missing-chicken troubleshooting checklist No fence plus an open door lets chickens wander off for good. Community-confirmed Community discussion scan archive (local file: community-scan-2026-08-08.md, 90 topics scanned, 44 read) Without the Angela heater/AC, chickens die from heat or cold stress. Community-confirmed Steam thread "Animals keep dying" (multiple players) Before 0.8.10.562, one player reported that reloading the save sometimes respawned a vanished chicken. Historical Steam thread "A temp chicken issue fix!" (LittleGhost and others)

title: Selling & profit

description: Selling live animals is not implemented. The official recommendation for surplus chickens and roosters is to dispatch them with an axe, pickaxe or weapon and sell the meat. The animal must be placed on the ground first — tools do not work while carrying it (that is intended, not a bug). Single-source numbers — meat out-earning eggs is the corroborated direction, the figures are not. Single-source Steam thread "Livestock profit" (Numinex, BeBeForever16) Five breeds in the cattle-shop directory, with related quest, care instructions and product names.

title: Barn automation: Feature Kits, Silos and Water Towers
parentTitle: The Ranchers Animal Database — Confirmed Roster & Data Tracker
description: Official A full livestock-automation layer for barns and coops is officially documented in the pre-EA Ranching v2 update notes — with the caveat that current Early Access behavior (0.8.10.x) has not yet been independently rechecked : Auto-Feeding Kit — feeds your animals automatically. Official · pre-EA documented Air Conditioning Kit — prevents animals from becoming ill by keeping them warm in winter and cool in summer. Official · pre-EA documented Silos and Water Towers — supply buildings; combining Feature Kits with Silos and Water Towers automates whole-livestock feeding. Official · pre-EA documented Troughs — craftable feeding stations for animals outside the barn/coop or raised fully outdoors. Official · pre-EA documented Linkage system — buildings and feature kits link to each other; hover with the hammer equipped to see connections. Barn and coop doors can be opened or closed at will, with benefits and consequences. Official · pre-EA documented In the current build the water contract with the mayor is required before a water tower fills, and the tower's link radius is smaller than a silo's. Community-confirmed Kit prices, coverage ranges and crafting requirements were not published in the official notes and remain pending current-build observation.

title: The Ranchers Map & Sunvale Location Finder
description: Explore the complete Sunvale map with 58 exact current-build POI anchors for shops, services, transport and landmarks, plus a source-graded directory of 29 places.

sections.heading: The Ranchers Map & Location Finder
sections.text: Open the in-game Map app, then search for a place below or click a map marker to see its details.

sections.heading: No matching location yet
sections.text: Try a purpose such as “seeds,” “car repair,” or “fast travel.” If the place is missing, submit its map name and a current-build screenshot .

sections.heading: Found a shop, NPC or useful pin?
sections.text: Send the exact map label, game build, nearby landmark and a screenshot you created. We manually review every report and publish only what can be traced and checked.

sections.heading: Sources and limits
sections.text: Reviewed August 24, 2026. The site owner collected the clean map, native POI sprites and named level6 transforms from the permitted local map capture. That evidence proves the displayed POI names and anchors; it does not by itself prove that every interior, service, price or historical activity is currently available. Those gameplay details remain separately source-graded.

Native map and POI artwork are used with developer permission on this independent fan guide. The Ranchers names and artwork remain the developer's property. Normal drag, long-press and context-menu image actions are disabled as a misuse deterrent, not DRM. All fixed anchors are visible by default. Toggle marker types only when you want a simpler view. Nearby locations stay at their source coordinates and appear together in the details panel when selected. Filter by original map icon All icons stay fixed to their source coordinates. Use these smaller types to isolate one kind of place without moving nearby labels. Quest highlighting only covers locations with a verified map anchor; task entries without a coordinate stay searchable in the directory. Coordinate evidence and gameplay evidence are separate A named POI transform proves an anchor, but not an open interior, current stock, price or quest use.

title: Leafy Market
description: Community data: Shopping Leafy Market Officially described as a grocery chain carrying fresh produce, seeds and farming supplies. The permitted current-build map resources expose seven separate Leafy Market POIs around the city. Interior confirmed in the current build Video-observed (Games Station, 03:15–03:55) : the shop UI is split into four tabs — Seed & Fertilizer / Vegetables / Grocery / Weaponry (Temporary) — and the in-store scene shows the green leaf logo with a cashier NPC at the counter. Observed retail shelf prices remain purchase prices, not player sell prices; see the money-making guide for the current evidence boundary. How to recognize it: enable the Shopping layer and look for the seven native grocery-store symbols. Selecting any branch opens this shared chain entry. title: The Ranchers Problems & Fixes | Current-Build Help
description: Source-backed fixes and decision guides for The Ranchers Early Access: offline loading, co-op joining, vehicle recovery, fast travel and failed quests.

sections.heading: The Ranchers Problems & Fixes
sections.text: Short decision guides for problems that players actually report. Every answer names its build, evidence level and source; unresolved reports stay in the research queue instead of becoming guessed fixes.

sections.heading: The Ranchers Problems & Fixes
sections.text: Current baseline: 0.8.10.842 · Last reviewed: August 22, 2026 · How we verify

sections.heading: Find a fix or tracked report
sections.text: Search plain-language symptoms, then separate published answers from reports that still need reproduction. Early Access changes quickly, so check the evidence label before acting.

sections.heading: Find a fix or tracked report
sections.text: “Reported” means a player described it; it does not mean we reproduced it.

sections.heading: Known issues and fixes through build 0.8.10.842
sections.text: Every tracked issue keeps the build in which it was reported. Published fixes link to their full guide; open reports link to the research queue or the discussion where they were first described.

sections.heading: Offline Mode keeps loading or will not start
sections.text: Update first, then separate a known launch-build issue from a new save or Steam problem.

sections.heading: A friend cannot join the ranch
sections.text: Check build parity, Steam visibility and the in-game travel route in the correct order.

sections.heading: A vehicle is stuck, broken or impounded
sections.text: Choose My Garage, Car Pound or a mechanic based on ownership and license status.

sections.heading: How subway and quest fast travel work
sections.text: Know which trips allow a skip and what happens to passengers, vehicles and attached animals.

sections.heading: A quest failed or cannot be restarted
sections.text: Use the current replay behavior and identify cases that still need a new report.

sections.heading: Roof objective is not recognized
sections.text: Officially confirmed quest-tracker issue: check the phone quest journal (T), sleep to the next day, or restart the client.

sections.heading: Seed plots partially disappear overnight
sections.text: A launch-week Steam review describes planted plots vanishing after the day transition. We have not reproduced the trigger or confirmed whether the seeds, plots or save state are affected.

sections.heading: Strawberries disappear before the expected harvest
sections.text: A Steam review reports losing strawberries before harvest. Season, crop stage, weather and sleep timing are still unknown.

sections.heading: Exiting a vehicle can drop the player through the map
sections.text: A launch-week review reports falling through terrain after leaving a vehicle. Vehicle type, road position and recovery behavior still need a clean reproduction.

sections.heading: Furniture or door-deck placement is blocked
sections.text: A Steam thread describes furniture placement failing and a translated house objective asking for a piece that was not visible at the workbench.

sections.heading: Power to the Bench does not progress
sections.text: The report is tracked, but the site does not yet have a current-build sequence that proves the required contract, cable or bench state.

sections.heading: Excess electricity cannot be sold as expected
sections.text: Official material says surplus energy can be sold, but current activation conditions, meter behavior and payout timing have not been retained as evidence.

sections.heading: No matching report
sections.text: Try a shorter symptom. If it is still missing, send a build number and reproduction steps .

sections.heading: A safer order for troubleshooting
sections.text: Most reports do not need a risky reset. Start with the least destructive check that can distinguish an old report from a current symptom.

sections.heading: A safer order for troubleshooting
sections.text: Confirm the build and mode. Write down the title-screen version, platform, single-player or co-op mode, and whether the save is new or continued.

sections.heading: A safer order for troubleshooting
sections.text: Preserve the original state. Keep a backup or screenshot before moving an animal, vehicle, quest item or building.

sections.heading: A safer order for troubleshooting
sections.text: Repeat one trigger. Test only the action that caused the symptom, then note what changed. Do not combine a reload, demolition and quest replay into one test.

sections.heading: A safer order for troubleshooting
sections.text: Use the evidence status honestly. A published guide is an available path, while an open report is a lead that still needs reproduction. See how those labels work .

sections.heading: Read the community before guessing
sections.text: Read the measured Community Pulse , open Steam Discussions with your existing account, or send evidence for manual review.

title: The Ranchers Offline Mode Not Loading | Current Fix
description: What to do when The Ranchers will not load in Steam Offline Mode: required hotfix, safe checks, evidence limits and current-build escalation steps.

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: Install build 0.8.10.842 or later while Steam is online , launch the game once after the update, close it normally, and only then switch Steam to Offline Mode. The first official Early Access hotfix specifically addresses the Offline Mode loading problem.

sections.heading: Safe fix sequence
sections.text: Go online long enough to update. Steam cannot install the launch hotfix while it is fully offline. Open the game's Properties or Downloads view and allow the update to finish.

sections.heading: Safe fix sequence
sections.text: Confirm the build. Use the version shown by the game and do not assume Steam's “up to date” message proves a specific build. This guide's minimum is 0.8.10.842.

sections.heading: Safe fix sequence
sections.text: Complete one online launch. Let the updated build reach its normal menu, then exit through the game's own quit flow. This avoids testing an update that has never completed its first launch.

sections.heading: Safe fix sequence
sections.text: Switch Steam to Offline Mode. Restart Steam when prompted, then launch the same local installation and choose solo play.

sections.heading: Safe fix sequence
sections.text: Test before changing the save. Do not delete, rename or replace saves to solve a loading issue until the updated build has been tested. Save destruction is not part of the official fix.

sections.heading: Offline solo and online co-op are different tests
sections.text: The hotfix permits solo use through Steam Offline Mode, but online co-op still requires Steam authentication and an internet connection. A co-op session failing while Steam is offline is therefore expected behavior, not proof that the offline loading fix failed.

It is not a claim that every later loading problem has the same cause.

title: The Ranchers Friend Cannot Join | Co-op Checklist
description: Fix The Ranchers co-op joining problems by checking build parity, Steam friendship and visibility, internet access and the subway travel route.

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: Both players should update to the same current build, remain signed in to Steam, be Steam friends and appear online rather than invisible . The joining player then uses a subway station to travel to the friend's ranch. The launch hotfix fixes some failed friend-session joins, so do not troubleshoot an older build.

sections.text: Match the build. Update every player to the current build, recorded here as 0.8.10.842. Do not compare menu access until each player confirms the displayed build.

sections.heading: Check these in order
sections.text: Keep Steam online. Solo play supports Steam Offline Mode, but co-op does not. Both players need Steam sign-in and internet access.

sections.heading: Check these in order
sections.text: Confirm Steam friendship. The community moderator's joining instructions require the players to be friends on Steam.

sections.heading: Check these in order
sections.text: Appear online. Invisible status can prevent the expected friend route from appearing. Set both accounts to an online-visible state for the test.

sections.heading: Check these in order
sections.text: Use the subway route. Travel through a subway station to the other player's ranch. Do not assume the game uses a conventional lobby browser or direct-IP flow.

sections.heading: Check these in order
sections.text: Change one condition at a time. If the join fails, record which player hosted, which player traveled, both builds and the last visible message before changing settings.

title: The Ranchers Vehicle Stuck, Broken or Impounded | Recovery Guide
description: Choose the correct The Ranchers vehicle recovery route: My Garage, mechanic, Car Pound, Overnight Parking or license plate rules for stolen vehicles.

sections.heading: Answer first
sections.text: Use My Garage for an owned vehicle that is broken, destroyed, drowned or stuck. Repaired vehicles return through the nearest Car Pound parking location. A vehicle left outside your ranch or an approved Overnight Parking location can be impounded instead, and stolen vehicles have separate license-plate rules.

sections.heading: Choose the route by vehicle state
